title: TH vs D and V
subtitle: Dental vs Dental Stops
description: The TH sound is often replaced with /d/ or /v/ by non-native speakers. Training your ear and tongue on these contrasts will make your speech immediately clearer.
tip: For TH, let your tongue peek out slightly; for D, your tongue hits the ridge just behind your top teeth and stays inside.
phrases: There they go — three of them together down the road.
They said the door over there was never the right one.
This day and that day — every other day it varies.
The driver thought the other vehicle had veered.
Do they know whether that vine over there is dead?
That dove flew over the den and then vanished.
